packaging: The npm package co-locates command handling, SQLite operational storage and installation implementations; logical responsibility remains distinct.

sources.basis: Static inspection of the successor working-tree source identifies this implementation binding. It does not establish passing tests, installed availability, publication or engineering approval. Prior observations remain recoverable at 39be9c81.

placements.name: CLI runtime package
constraints: Paths are relative to the CLI package root selected by npm installation or the source package directory. The package manifest maps the rigorloop binary to dist/bin/rigorloop.js; no installation is performed by this architecture pass.

The same package contains command, record-store, and installer implementations plus bundled metadata. Co-packaging does not merge their architectural accountability; package production and release remain separately owned.

physical_bindings.name: Consumer CLI package and selected storage

accesses.purpose: Read/write project-local SQLite records and selected payloads.
conditions: Explicit project association and supported task admission are required.
A physical access relationship is neither an execution sequence nor evidence of durable success.

accesses.purpose: Coordinate ordinary leases and fenced maintenance capture/recovery.
conditions: Explicit project association and supported task admission are required.
A physical access relationship is neither an execution sequence nor evidence of durable success.

accesses.purpose: Preflight selected target units and perform verified creation or explicitly permitted whole-unit replacement.
conditions: Installation uses the invoking working directory. codex and claude select alternative target roots; their units are not both installed by every request.
Dry-run performs only its admitted preliminary inspection; real writes require candidate verification, destination safety, and applicable explicit replacement permission.

accesses.purpose: Stage candidate files and preserve detached originals outside target discovery while performing an admitted installation.
conditions: This placement participates in real installation after preflight. Dry-run does not create it.
The installer reports retained originals and actual partial scope; the binding does not promise cleanup, whole-project rollback, or unconditional replacement.

accesses.purpose: Append bounded diagnostics for eligible invocations and read the selected retained invocation on explicit log lookup.
conditions: Primary/advanced recording and retired-command admission bypass the generic logging wrapper; other eligible commands may have file logging disabled or degraded.

The configured log root is selected independently of the record --root and installation working directory. This aggregate access describes distinct append and lookup paths, not a requirement that each invocation reads and writes logs.

constraints: The package mapping references the existing CLI package placement, while execution references the one existing Node.js process. A package is an artifact, not a process or host; its contained logical responsibilities remain separately allocated.
Each access names the responsible execution participant. Sharing one process does not imply that installation reads operational records or that every command accesses every placement.
The record command's selected project, installation working directory, and diagnostic root are independent address selections. Similar names neither equate them nor place them on different hosts.

The CLI resolves bundled metadata relative to its executable/package tree. The runtime mapping supplies no minimum Node version, installed-artifact observation, agent-host execution, or hardware topology.
